modules.name: Module1
modules.source:
Option Explicit
Public Function Probe(ByVal x As Variant) As Variant
    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Data").Range("A1").Value2 = x
    Probe = x * 2
End Function
Public Function ErrProbe() As Variant
    On Error GoTo 100
    Err.Raise 5, "Module1", "probe error"
    Exit Function
100:
    ErrProbe = Array("Touchstone.Vba.Err", CLng(Err.Number), Err.Description)
End Function

Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Events").Range("A1").Value2 = "Change"
End Sub
